sceneConcept: A lively forty-eight-year-old Chinese teahouse owner stands alone against a transparent background. She has a warm round face, short brown permed curls, brown eyes and a broad welcoming smile. A cream blouse with rolled sleeves sits under a practical red apron, with relaxed brown trousers and dark flat shoes. Her left hand holds one plain brown ceramic teapot, while her empty right hand lifts beside her mouth as she calls cheerfully across the room. Soft even frontal studio light keeps the scene warmly ordinary. Visual refresh: a warm red apron over a soft brown cardigan with practical dark skirt.
